name: Coca
body:
Coca CR
8

A vaguely dragon-like creature, apparently made of many mismatched vegetable parts, lurches towards you with a hungry light in the hollow orbits of its bare skull.

XP 4,800
NE Medium undead
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)
hp 102 (12d8+48)
Fort +7, Ref +7, Will +11
Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 10 ft.
Melee bite +15 (1d6+6 plus grab), 2 claws +15 (1d4+6)
Special Attacks shadow bolt (DC 19), swallow whole (1d4+4 negative energy, AC 13, 10 hp)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12th, concentration +15)

At will—detect anxieties (DC 16), frightful form (DC 19), prestidigitation (DC 14)
1/day—fear (DC 18), phantasmal killer (DC 18)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 17, Con —, Int 14, Wis 16, Cha 17
Base Atk +9; CMB +15; CMD 28 (32 vs. trip)
Feats Critical Focus, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Tiring Critical, Toughness
Skills Climb +29, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (local) +17, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +18
Languages Common, any language it spoke while alive

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Frightful Form (Sp)

As a standard action, a coca can use a special form of its detect anxieties spell-like ability, drawing forth an image of the deepest fears of a creature within 10 feet and transforming its body into a freakish phantasmagoria that frightens the target in the same round. The target takes 2d8+9 damage, or half as much if it succeeds on a Will saving throw. A creature failing its save is also frightened for 1 minute, though it can attempt a new saving throw each round to end that effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Shadow Bolt (Su)

As a standard action, a coca can fire a bolt of shadowy energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must make a Fortitude saving throw, taking 24 2d10+11 negative energy damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails the saving throw, it is also stunned for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any, inhabited settlements
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Cocas are bodiless entities. Similar to hermit crabs, they take possession of a receptacle (of natural origin) and transform it into their body or home, often a simple coconut shell. Once occupied by the coca’s spirit, the occupied container subtly shifts its appearance to resemble a sort of head, to which it adds limbs made of earth or plants, animating the whole by the power of its spirit. Cocas tend to hide in the shadows, lurking about seeking those they may snare and devour.

Their fell reputation is invoked by elders to caution misbehaving youngsters with stories of the creature, telling them, “If you don’t behave well, the coca will devour you!”

Variants

Murucututu: Not all cocas are inherently evil. Some are more like creepy guardian angels, guarding pathways and punishing those with ill intentions. These spirits, called murucututu, are skilled sentinels and mostly benevolent and may take the form of large owls with dark, shadowy wings, perched along ridgelines and at wayside markers at crossroads. Murucututus gain the shapechanger subtype and the change shape (Medium owl, beast shape I) special quality. It can revert to its true form as a free action.
